newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU jobless steady at 10.9 percent in Nov-Eurostat.
newsitem.headline: EU jobless steady at 10.9 percent in Nov-Eurostat.

text.p: European Union jobless figures for November showed 18.2 million people out of work in the 15-country bloc, or 10.9 percent of the workforce, a figure unchanged in the seven previous months, Eurostat said on Friday.

The EU statistics office said in a statement the largest falls in jobless rates during the year to November were in Britain (8.6 to 7.5), Denmark (6.6 to 5.5), Finland (16.2 to 15.3), Belgium (10 to 9.5) and Ireland (12.4 to 11.9).
During the same period, rates rose in Germany from 8.5 to 9.3 percent and in France from 11.8 to 12.5 percent.
Luxembourg's 3.3 percent rate and Austria's 4 percent pegged the lower end of the EU league table in November while Spain's stood at 22.3 percent and Finland's at 15.3 percent.
Eurostat gave no November figure for Greece, Italy or the Netherlands.
It said U.S. unemployment amounted to 5.4 percent during the same month and gave Japan's jobless for the previous month as 3.4 percent.
